build_features: renderer default (CPU reference path is the same with skia)

commands.primary: before/after executable --case CASE --samples 100 --runs 1, outer_trial=0..4; reverse case order and after-first on odd trials
commands.confirmation: before/after executable --case small|stress --samples 200 --runs 1, outer_trial=0..4; after-first on odd trials

timing_protocol: No builds or tests overlapped accepted timing, profiling and resource measurements. No system-wide CPU isolation. Cold source each process; warm samples follow the first draw. Full output equality and document_state serialization checks occur outside the timed interval.
